alerts.detail: Run 2 on 24 Sep. No unknown service codes. AUG (Asia-U.S. GULF Service, per the EVER LUCKY 085E LINE: label) showed on Pusan, Cai Mep and Yantian to Houston. It is already in the registry, so it is not an XL. HTW (Asia-U.S. Southwest Coast Express, calls Los Angeles, Oakland and Tacoma, then rail to Houston) showed on Cai Mep to Houston. It is already on the deny-list. NSB and KTH on Pusan to New York are also on the deny-list. Hapag fixture Yantian to New York gave AA7 5, US4 7. AA7 was not flagged, so the fixture passes.

No OGEC 0022 on Evergreen Yantian, Shanghai or Pusan to New York, Yantian or Shanghai or Ningbo to Savannah, second pass from 19 Oct. The expected weekly OGEC cadence has not shown up after 0021. EVER LASTING 0021-097E is still in the window (Pusan ETD 27 Sep).
